An '''unidentified [[TIE series/Legends|TIE Series]] variant''' was seen in use in [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]]. Incorporating components visibly similar to those comprising the [[TIE/sa tactical bomber/Legends|TIE/sa bomber]], this [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]]-capable [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] was used in a [[Battle near the Itani Nebula|special operation]] commissioned by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] to bring his wayward apprentice, an [[Subject 1138|apparent]] [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] of [[Galen Marek]], back under his control.

==Characteristics==
This TIE variant was composed of three fuselage cylinders in an arrangement nearly identical to the [[TIE Heavy Bomber]],<ref name="SWGB">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]''</ref> but lacking the ventral ordnance pod. In place of the concave solar array wings of the [[TIE/sa tactical bomber/Legends|TIE/sa bomber]], this variant was equipped with outward-canted wing panels<ref name="TFU2Comic" /> very similar to those of the [[TIE/d "Defender" Multi-Role Starfighter/Legends|TIE/D Defender]]<ref name="DefenderDB">{{DB|starship|tiedefender|TIE defender}}</ref> or an inverted mounting of those on the [[TIE/ad starfighter]].<ref name="AvengerDB">{{DB|starship|tieavenger|TIE avenger}}</ref>

Like those fighters or the [[TIE/IN interceptor/Legends|TIE/IN interceptor]],<ref name="InterceptorDB">{{DB|starship|tieinterceptor|TIE interceptor}}</ref> it had energy weapons at the tips of its wing panels, though it was only seen to use [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion cannons]]. The port-side pods both carried two large projectile launchers which fired a unique type of boarding pod that carried [[Terror Trooper]]s and/or [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]].<ref name="TFU2Comic" />

Operated by a single [[TIE pilot]], the ships were [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]]-equipped, with sufficient range to travel from [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] to the [[Itani Nebula/Legends|Itani Nebula]]. Their [[Twin ion engine/Legends|twin ion engines]] could keep pace with [[Slave I/Legends|''Slave I'']] at attack speed.<ref name="TFU2Comic" />

==Role==
In the only event in which these TIE variants have been seen in use, they were part of a strike force used to assault the [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate]] [[Salvation (flagship)|''Salvation'']]. They engaged the ''Salvation''{{'s}} fighter screen, deployed boarding troops, and assaulted the frigate directly, disabling its main reactor.<ref name="TFU2Comic" />

==History==
[[File:Podsaway.jpg|thumb|right|300px|The TIE variant firing [[boarding torpedo]]es.]]

This class of starfighter was assigned by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] to a strike force utilized by the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] to capture [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Juno Eclipse/Legends|Juno Eclipse]]. The objective of this capture was to use Eclipse as leverage against Vader's wayward apprentice, an apparent [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] of [[Galen Marek]].<ref name="TFU2Comic" />

==Behind the scenes==
The TIE ship appears in [[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II (graphic novel)|''Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II'' comic]], a [[2010]] adaptation of the [[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II|game of the same name]].<ref name="TFU2Comic" /> Although several ships are mentioned as attacking the ''Salvation'' fleet in the [[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II (novelization)|novelization]], they are not identified as the TIEs.<ref name="TFU2novel">[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II (novelization)|''Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II'' novelization]]</ref>
